# NFL Daily — 2026-11-13 (Past 1 day(s))

## Summary
- Ravens QB Lamar Jackson is out 6-10 weeks after surgery on a broken and dislocated thumb; Jacoby Brissett takes over at quarterback. [ESPN](https://www.espn.com/nfl/story/_/id/50472222/ravens-lamar-jackson-injury-typical-line-6-10-weeks)

# Baltimore Ravens — 2026-11-13 (Past 1 day(s))

## Key news
- Lamar Jackson underwent surgery on a broken and dislocated right thumb; the Ravens say he's expected to miss 6-10 weeks. [Ravens](https://www.baltimoreravens.com/news/lamar-jackson-injury-jesse-minter-ravens-statement-timeline-broken-dislocated-thumb)
- Jacoby Brissett will start at quarterback in Jackson's absence as Baltimore looks to "play our best football over the second half of the season," per coach Jesse Minter. [CBS Sports](https://www.cbssports.com/nfl/news/ravens-announce-lamar-jackson-surgery-broken-dislocated-thumb-out-6-10-weeks/)
